source.title: Salazer - Lash of Bantus
source.name: Salazer
source.description: A Rogue who can imprison enemies with low HP.

skills.name: Rain of Blades

description.raw: Salazer summons plenty of Flying Swords to launch 9 strikes to an enemy with the highest HP. Each strike deals 30% (ATK-based) damage plus damage equal to 5% + 0.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP. Additional damage cannot exceed 150% + 10% (SP-based) of Salazer's ATK. Salazer prioritizes the enemy with the most HP.
active: Salazer summons plenty of Flying Swords to launch 9 strikes to an enemy with the highest HP.
Each strike deals 30% (ATK-based) damage plus damage equal to 5% + 0.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP.
Additional damage cannot exceed 150% + 10% (SP-based) of Salazer's ATK.
Salazer prioritizes the enemy with the most HP.

text: Unlocks at level 51: The damage dealt by this skill gratns Salazer 50 Life Drain.
Unlocks at level 111: The damage of each strike is increased to 32% (ATK-based) plus damage equal to 5.5% + 0.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP.
Unlocks at level 171: The damage of each strike is increased to 34% (ATK-based) plus damage equal to 6% + 0.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP.
Unlocks at level 231: The damage of each strike is increased to 36% (ATK-based) plus damage equal to 6.5% + 0.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP.

skills.description_lite: Summons flying swords to deal damage to the enemy.

skills.name: Enraptured Whip

description.raw: Salazer whips enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage. When the target's HP ratio drops below 70%, Salazer launches one more attack to enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 230% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.
active: Salazer whips enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage.
When the target's HP ratio drops below 70%, Salazer launches one more attack to enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 230% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.

text: Increases the damage to 185% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and the damage of additional whip attack to 235% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).
Increases the damage to 190% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and the damage of additional whip attack to 240% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).
Increases the damage to 200% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and the damage of additional whip attack to 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Salazer whips enemies within the radius of an arc, dealing extra damage once if the enemy's HP ratio is low after being hit.

skills.name: Spirit Shackles

description.raw: Salazer imprisons an enemy whose HP ratio is less than 70%, dealing 300% (ATK-based) damage and making them unable to move or act for 5 + 1.5 (SP-based)s. The skill can only be applied to each enemy once.
active: Salazer imprisons an enemy whose HP ratio is less than 70%, dealing 300% (ATK-based) damage and making them unable to move or act for 5 + 1.5 (SP-based)s.
The skill can only be applied to each enemy once.

text: Everytime Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 8% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends.
The skill can absorb up to 50% of Salazer's ATK in each battle.
Everytime Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 10% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends.
The skill can absorb up to 50% of Salazer's ATK in each battle.
Everytime Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 12% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends.

skills.description_lite: Salazer deals massive damage to an enemy with a low HP ratio, making them unable to move or act.

description.raw: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.
active: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.

text: Reduces damage taken by 16% during battle.
Reduces damage taken by 20% during battle.

skills.name: Soul Drench

description.raw: Salazer immerses himself in the power of the Spirits and casts Enraptured Whip 1 times without cooldown when a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. An extra whip strike will be attempted.
active: Salazer immerses himself in the power of the Spirits and casts Enraptured Whip 1 times without cooldown when a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned.
An extra whip strike will be attempted.

text: The Enraptured Whip deals additional damage equal to 5% of the enemy's current HP, granting 50 Life Drain to Salazer.
The additional damage cannot exceed 150% of Salazer's ATK.
Casts Enraptured Whip 2 times without cooldown.
The Enraptured Whip deals additional damage equal to 5.5% of the enemy's current HP, granting 52 Life Drain to Salazer.
The additional damage cannot exceed 160% of Salazer's ATK.

skills.description_lite: The Enraptured Whip has no cooldown after a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. A guaranteed whip attempt will be added.
